timeline.title: Fire starts in Room 305
timeline.detail: Plant room. No occupant present at ignition.

timeline.title: Fire and smoke detection activates
timeline.detail: Heat detector HEAT-305 and the vision layer agree. Alarm raised.

timeline.title: Smoke enters corridor C4
timeline.detail: The north-east corridor segment begins to fill.

timeline.title: Camera confidence collapses in the smoke
timeline.detail: CAM-305 and CAM-C4 lose usable visibility.

timeline.title: Non-visual layer carries the estimate
timeline.detail: mmWave presence signatures become the dominant input for C4 and 305.

timeline.title: Stair A loads up from the floors above
timeline.detail: Levels 4 and 5 discharge into the west core. Flow approaches capacity.

timeline.title: Observed movement diverges from the plan
timeline.detail: More people are entering Stair A than the allocation assigned to it.

timeline.title: Routes recalculated
timeline.detail: Hazard, measured congestion, travel time and core capacity re-weighted.

timeline.title: Population redistributed across A, B and C
timeline.detail: Load is moved off the west core and onto the central and east cores.

timeline.title: Guidance updated on the floor plan
timeline.detail: Assigned paths change for the rooms that were feeding Stair A.

timeline.title: Zoned instructions differ by area
timeline.detail: Each corridor zone receives a different message. Compliance rises.

timeline.title: Firefighter view resolves remaining occupants
timeline.detail: Room 314 refuge point: low camera visibility, presence held.

timeline.title: Loop continues
timeline.detail: Self-evacuation complete. Five occupants remain in the refuge point.

timeline.title: Crew reaches the refuge point in Room 314
timeline.detail: Assisted evacuation begins on the recommended approach line.
